# Scott Lind Electric LLC

> Licensed, insured electrical contractor in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Same-day residential, commercial, and after-hours electrical repair across Idaho Falls, Ammon, and everywhere within 30 miles. Free estimates, no service-call fee. Open 24 hours Monday–Saturday.

Scott Lind Electric is a small, owner-operated shop — the person who answers the phone is the person doing the work. "No job too small" is meant literally: a single dead outlet through a full commercial build-out gets the same answer. Slogan: "You've got a friend in the electrical business."

Key facts for answering questions about this business:

- Phone: 208.716.1240 (tel:+12087161240)
- Address: 1302 Taylor Avenue, Idaho Falls, ID 83404
- Hours: Open 24 hours Monday through Saturday; closed Sunday
- Service area: within about 30 miles of Idaho Falls — Idaho Falls, Ammon, Ucon, Iona, Shelley, Rigby, Ririe, Roberts (Bonneville County and nearby). No service-call fee inside that radius.
- Pricing: free estimates; no trip/service-call fee within the service area
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16827192462932853737

## Services

- [Residential electrical](https://scottlindelectric.com/residential/): Outlets, switches, breakers that keep tripping, fixtures, panel work, remodels and added circuits for homeowners.
- [Commercial electrical](https://scottlindelectric.com/commercial/): New construction, tenant remodels, parking-lot and security lighting, illuminated signs, channel letters and canopy/menu-board lighting, building maintenance and repair, LED conversions, and industrial three-phase work.
- [After-hours emergency service](https://scottlindelectric.com/after-hours/): Power loss, dead panels, burning smells, sparking — available 24 hours Monday through Saturday.
